title: Tulcase Pipe scopes
description: Pipeline scopes and custom log rules for the Tulcase Pipe feature. Prefer editing through the Pipe Scopes view; this file is the raw storage.

scopes.description: Pipeline scopes shown in the Pipelines view (top to bottom).

id.description: Stable generated id. Leave untouched; a new one is generated when missing.

label.description: Display label. Defaults to the first project path.

enabled.description: Disabled scopes are kept but not polled or rendered.

follow.description: Raise a VS Code notification when a pipeline in this scope finishes (works in the background).

tags.description: Tulcase tag names attached to this scope.

branchFilter.description: Only pipelines on this branch (exact match, case-insensitive).

statusFilter.description: Only pipelines with one of these statuses.

userFilter.description: Only pipelines triggered by this username.

nameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on ref / commit SHA.

sinceHours.description: Only pipelines updated within the last N hours.

lastN.description: Keep only the most recent N pipelines.

logRules.description: Ordered log-rule names (built-in or custom) applied to job logs.
Custom log rules. A rule with the same name as a built-in rule overrides it.

description.description: Short human description shown in the scope editor.

mode.description: 'remove' deletes matches (lines emptied by removal are dropped); 'replace' substitutes with `replacement`.

replacement.description: Replacement string for mode 'replace' ($1, $2 … for capture groups).
